templates.title: International Conference On-Duty (OD) Leave & Travel Grant
templates.purpose: Request on-duty leave and eligible travel grant support for presenting an accepted research paper at an international conference.
templates.instructions: Applicants must present proof of paper acceptance, ID card, and grant approval before travel. Reimbursement claims must adhere to institutional finance norms.

templates.title: Academic Leave Request
templates.purpose: Apply for academic or personal leave under institutional policy with teaching work coverage.
templates.instructions: Submit at least 3 days prior. Work coverage arrangement must be signed off by department peer.

templates.title: Research Funding Request
templates.purpose: Request institutional seed grant funding for an approved research project or scholarly investigation.
templates.instructions: Detailed budget breakdown and timeline must be attached for R&D Council verification.

templates.title: Research Procurement & Equipment Request
templates.purpose: Request hardware, specialized lab equipment, or research software licenses within approved budget limits.
templates.instructions: Attach three competitive vendor quotes if value exceeds ₹25,000.

templates.title: Event & Auditorium Booking
templates.purpose: Reserve campus auditoriums, seminar halls, and AV support for academic conferences or symposiums.
templates.instructions: Must be booked at least 10 days in advance of the scheduled event date.

templates.title: Travel / Supervision No-Objection Certificate (NOC)
templates.purpose: Official clearance certificate for external doctoral viva supervision, evaluation duty, or industrial visits.
templates.instructions: Attach formal invitation letter from the requesting university or regulatory body.
